Screenshot of the System Admin page with the "Configuration" tab selected. The right panel shows a search box at the top, then five tabs: Auth, Daily schedule, Timeouts, Ceilings, Environment. The active tab shows a 2-column card grid of settings. Each card has a label, description, the current value (text input, switch, or time picker), and Reset / Save buttons. A small orange restart icon appears next to settings that require a service restart. The "Environment" tab lists read-only values from the host .env file with secrets masked as "***** (32 chars)". Dimensions: 1280x900px.
